reason: B offers a more substantive, composition-controlled and testable mechanism, with prior evidence linking severe plastic deformation, ultrafine grains, and Cr enrichment of stainless-steel passive films. Its study should additionally control HPT-induced residual stress/defects and directly test Cr transport, but A is largely a generic restatement of established chromium passivation and oversimplifies aqueous passive films as pure Cr2O3.
